title: An open session sets the stage label when archived sessions are also on the pull request
description: An open session sets the stage label when archived sessions are also on the pull request
acceptance_criteria: A pull request that introduces an archived session at done and an open session at intent is labeled chough-stage:intent, and the done label is removed. A pull request whose only introduced session is an archived story at done is labeled chough-stage:done. Two open sessions at different stages still get no stage label. The two script copies stay byte-identical.

answers.constraints: tasks.md has no unchecked boxes. The two script copies stay byte-identical. The delta is frozen once approved. Do not edit the approved keep-label change or archived records. Do not merge.
